messages:
Priya: thanks for the all-hands clarity earlier! quick ops questions about the upcoming Q2 regional meetups.
Liam: are we providing a per-diem or reimbursing actuals for meals during 2-day meetups?
Anya: we reimburse actuals up to a per-diem cap: $60/day domestic, $90/day international. Save receipts.
Nina: is childcare covered if someone needs to travel and has young kids?
Anya: we have a childcare subsidy for travel emergencies—submit a short note and receipts; approvals are case-by-case.
Liam: hotel booking: should we use the company travel portal or book direct?
PeopleOpsBot: use travel.redwood.example for company-rate hotels. If booking outside portal, include reason in expense notes.
Priya: remote day coverage: if someone attends in person, do they need to post a calendar note for asynchronous meetings?
Anya: please mark 'In-office for meetup' on calendar and set OOO for blocks you won't cover. Team leads should coordinate coverage.
Nina: badge access in London office changed last month — any updates for the meetup?
PeopleOpsBot: London office: temporary guest badges will be issued for meetup dates. Bring ID, register on the visitor form: https://redwood.example/london-visit
Liam: visa support for APAC travel?
Anya: People Ops will provide a letter of invitation and preferred vendor for visa services for company-organized travel. DM me the dates.
Priya: can we get a 1-paragraph summary for handbook? Happy to draft.
Anya: pls draft — tag me and I'll add approval notes. We'll pin the final in #people-ops. Thanks all :pray:
